full_query: Can I take nyquil and benedryl at the same time?
sentences: It is not recommended to take NyQuil and Benadryl at the same time
Both medications contain antihistamines: NyQuil usually contains doxylamine, and Benadryl contains diphenhydramine
Taking them together can increase the risk of side effects such as severe drowsiness, dizziness, confusion, and impaired coordination
Moreover, combining these medications can also potentially lead to an overdose of antihistamines, which can be dangerous
